facts.fact: The Ministry of Transport and Communications' National Broadband Strategy says Botswana has a fibre optic backbone network in the form of a ring owned by BoFiNet, with private operators such as Mascom also having deployed national backbone infrastructure; it describes the backbone as connecting all urban centres and major villages (document gives June 2018 publication date, no earlier date).
BoFiNet reported at its 13 August 2026 AGM 99.7% service availability across its national fibre backbone (News&All Botswana report, no regions or km given).
The article describes BoFiNet's national mandate as the country's wholesale open-access fibre and broadband infrastructure provider; buyers are not named.

note: Village fibre access (191 customers in three villages) is local access, not a national backbone fact; backbone only mentioned as BoFiNet's mandate.
Village fibre access, not a national backbone fact.
No backbone statement; rural access programme only.

facts.fact: Communications minister David Tshere said approximately 16,000 km of fibre optic cable is already laid across Botswana, linking the country internally and to South Africa, Namibia, Zimbabwe and Zambia; the document gives no towns or regions and does not say 'lit' or name the owner (published date used as as_of).

facts.fact: The minister referred to the existing national backbone network, which has aged, and said segments would be upgraded to give 45 major villages reliable high-speed internet.
The minister said seven new optical fibre links would be implemented in 2024/25 by BoFiNet; the Sebina-Nshakashokwe-Tutume link was complete and Takatokwane-Morwamosu was due that month.
BoFiNet's Acting CEO says it has laid about 12,400 km of fibre covering over 80% of the population, with about 2,000 km more needed to reach the remaining villages.
BoFiNet's Acting CEO says it holds a wholesale-only licence and sells capacity to ISPs and mobile operators.

note: The 840 km Kalahari Fiber is a link to the Namibian landing station, not a backbone between the capital and other regions.
